missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics showing cause of 503 (e.g., saturation, dependency failure, config)
Payment dependency traces (postgresql or upstream) to confirm origin of 503
candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 preceding order 502 and checkout 502 across all sampled correlation IDs; inventory reservations succeed (200).
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within payment (resource exhaustion vs config vs dependency) is not established; only the failing hop is bounded.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed. Payment-side cause is unconfirmed, so the candidate is bounded to the failing hop.
